questions.question: In a class, if 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups and if 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. How many students are present in the class?
questions.solution:
Let, the total number of students are x.

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups.

Equal parts are (x - 3)/7

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (x - 7)/9

According to the question,

(x - 3)/7 = (x - 7)/9 + 4

⇒ (9x - 27 - 7x + 49)/ 63 = 4

⇒ 2x + 22 = 63 × 4

⇒ 2x = 252 - 22

⇒ 2x = 230

⇒ x = 115.

Hence, the correct answer is **"115"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** By option elimination:

**__Option (1):__ 115**

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups. 

Equal parts are (115 - 3)/7 =112 / 7 = 16

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (115 - 7)/9 = 108 / 9 = 12 

**Therefore two conditions are satisfied. **

__Option (2):__ 140

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups. 

Equal parts are (140 - 3)/7 =**137 does not divide by 7.**

__Option (3____):__ 87

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups. 

Equal parts are (87 - 3)/7 = 84/7 = 12.

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (87 - 7)/9 = **80 does not divide by 9.**

__Option (4____): __101

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups. 

Equal parts are (101 - 3)/7 = 98/7 = 14.

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (101 - 7)/9 = **94 does not divide by 9.**

Hence, the correct answer is "115".

questions.question: ‘Up’ is related to ‘Down’ in the same way as ‘Cold’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Up’ is related to ‘Down’ → Up is antonym of Down.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Cold’ is related to ‘________’ → Cold is antonym of Hot.

Hence, '**Hot**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I) All computers are desktops.

II) Some computers are laptops.

**Conclusions:**

I) Some laptops are desktops.

II) All desktops are laptops.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d716ecaf16b2b58b231b048be8fb4e314c0d896cc7bd3e225bdf9e2f6e3fb2c.png] 

Conclusions:

I) Some laptops are desktops. → Follow (As, All computers are desktops and Some computers are laptops)

II) All desktops are laptops. → Do not follow (As, All computers are desktops and Some computers are laptops → All desktops are laptops)

Hence, **Only conclusion I follows**.

questions.question:
If ‘P’ denotes ‘+’, ‘Q’ denotes ‘−’, ‘R’ denotes ‘×’ and ‘S’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

(14 R 9) S 6 P 40 Q 1
questions.solution:

P

 
 
 
Q

 
 
 
R

 
 
 
S

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

(14 R 9) S 6 P 40 Q 1

After replacing letters by their meaning, we get:

__**(14 ×**____** 9)**__ ÷ 6 + 40 - 1

= **__126 __****__÷__****__ 6__** + 40 - 1

= __**21 + 40**__ - 1

= 61 - 1

= 60

Hence, '**60**' is the correct answer.
